title: ship.toml: one Ship's settings (/etc/shipshape/ship.toml)
description: Written by FleetLedger into the seed (W3) and by `ship-ctl set`; read by ship-provision and ship-ctl (W4, W5). TOML on disk; validated as the equivalent JSON value. See contracts/settings.md.

schema.description: Contract version. Bump only for breaking changes.

id.description: Random, fixed for the Ship's life.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the Ship's clock, for example Europe/Berlin. `ship-fleet new` sets it from the FleetLedger computer's zone. updates.reboot_time is in this zone.

sudo.description: Passwordless sudo for the agent user. Off by default.

lan_guard.description: Block new outgoing connections to private address ranges. Incoming connections (FleetLedger's SSH, attaching with herdr) and their replies are never affected.

lan_guard_allow.description: Extra addresses or CIDRs the guard lets through. The default gateway, the DNS servers and DHCP are always allowed.

ssh_listen.description: Where sshd accepts logins. any: every interface. overlay: only over the overlay network (and loopback); allowed only once the Ship has joined it (ship-ctl overlay join), and reset to any when it leaves.

auto_reboot.description: Let unattended-upgrades reboot the Ship at reboot_time when an update needs it. Off by default: a needed reboot is shown as attention instead.

reboot_time.description: Time of day for automatic reboots (HH:MM, 24 hours), in the Ship's own time zone (ship.timezone).

scopes.description: Extra GitHub scopes the Ship's GitHub sign-in asks for, beyond gh's own minimum (repo, read:org, gist). FleetLedger's sign-in passes them to gh auth login --scopes (or gh auth refresh on a Ship already signed in); ship-ctl status reports the scopes the token has and the attention item signin-scopes-differ when they differ. Empty: gh's minimum, as before.

owner.description: Your own login on the Ship, apart from agent (never an existing system account: uid below 1000 or 60000 and up): made by ship-ctl apply with useradd, with passwordless sudo, your keys (kept root-owned under /etc/ssh/shipshape/keys/) and user certificates for the owner login: principals owner:all, owner:tag:<tag> and owner:ship:<name>, never agent's. agent keeps no sudo.

autostart.description: Agents ship-ctl autostart starts when they are not already running. Names must be unique (checked by ship-ctl).

cwd.description: Working folder; ~/ means the agent user's home.

repo.description: A GitHub repo (owner/name) to clone into cwd before the agent starts there, once, as the agent; only into a folder that is empty or not there yet. A private repo waits for the Ship's GitHub sign-in (attention agent-repo-waiting), and is retried when GitHub becomes signed in.

profile_options.description: Per-profile option values, e.g. a repo URL. Keys are profile ids; values are string maps.

permissionMode.description: Claude Code permission modes; "default" is the mode Claude Code calls Manual.

githubScope.description: The extra GitHub scopes a Ship may ask for (FleetLedger's catalogue, fleetledger/ghscopes.py). Scopes that can delete or administer (delete_repo, admin:*) are deliberately not offered.

remote_control.description: on: remoteControlAtStartup true. off: remoteControlAtStartup false and disableRemoteControl true, which also keeps resumed sessions from reconnecting. blocked: an older name for off, identical to it; still accepted.

allow_bypass.description: false writes permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode = "disable" to managed settings.

session_prefix.description: Session names: sessions the Ship starts are named <session_prefix>-<agent> (claude --name). Also set as the Remote Control name prefix, which only names a session before its first message. Default: the Ship's name.
